steps.thought: I need to calculate the average number of bonds for iodine atoms. I'll query the connected.csv file to count bonds for each iodine atom (both as atom_id and atom_id2), then compute the average.

action_input.sql:
WITH iodine_atoms AS (
    SELECT 'TR110_2' as aid UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TR110_3' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TR110_4' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TR340_26' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TR340_44' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TR340_8'
),
iodine_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        ia.aid,
        COUNT(*) as bond_count
    FROM iodine_atoms ia
    LEFT JOIN df ON (df.atom_id = ia.aid OR df.atom_id2 = ia.aid)
    GROUP BY ia.aid
)
SELECT AVG(bond_count) as avg_bonds FROM iodine_bonds
